description.p: Saturn PCB Toolkit provides calculators for printed circuit board design, including trace and via current, impedance, differential pairs, crosstalk and padstacks.

This community package downloads the official Windows installer from Saturn PCB Design and runs it with Wine in a private prefix. The first launch takes longer while installation completes. Wine is a separate dependency: install it with flatpak install flathub org.winehq.Wine//stable-26.08.
The interface follows your desktop scale by default. If the text or controls are too small, close Saturn PCB Toolkit, change the DPI, and then reopen it.

ul.li: Use a larger scale with flatpak run --command=cellar com.saturnpcb.PCBToolkit config dpi=168.
Restore automatic scaling with flatpak run --command=cellar com.saturnpcb.PCBToolkit config dpi=auto.
